voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyayas 49–50: with most of the serpents burned, Vasuki, his limbs burning and his mind reeling as the mantras drag him toward the fire, tells his sister the time has come: let her son save them. She tells Astika why he was born; he promises his uncle he will free him from the curse, and goes. At the sacrifice the doorkeepers will not let him in; he praises the sacrifice (like those of Soma, Varuna and Prajapati), the king, the assembly and the fire, and is admitted. Janamejaya, delighted, says that though a boy he speaks like an elder, and wishes to give him a boon; the priests answer that the boy deserves it, but first Takshaka must come to the fire (the cliffhanger, 1.50–51).
structure: From episode 21: COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, ≤ 3 s; opening chosen by content (not a fixed rotation): direct speech in medias res by content: Vasuki's cry, the card at the side of his straining hood) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 4.5 s with the UNVOICED recap band over its first shot → turn at 40–60 % after one ≈ 0.9 s rest → the cliffhanger image + line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image that dissolves into frame 1. Gate: tools/gate.mjs (run by tools/render.mjs).

strings.recapLine: The fire blazed, and Vasuki felt it pulling him in.

lines.speaker: vasuki
lines.text: "My limbs are burning. Send your son!"
lines.say: My limbs are burning. [p:100] Send your son!
lines.note: COLD OPEN (direct speech in medias res, by content): Vasuki's hood straining at the frame's edge against a red glow, sparks rising past him from frame 1; the card beside him.

lines.text: Most of his people had burned. Now the spell was pulling Vasuki in.
lines.say: Most of his people had burned. [p:200] Now the spell was pulling Vasuki in.
lines.note: STORY 0 with the unvoiced recap band (top): Vasuki's hall lit red from above through a crack in the vault, the empty coils of the hall; Vasuki writhing on his throne-coil, gold mantra bands closing on him.

lines.text: His sister told her son why he had been born.
lines.say: His sister told her son [p:60] why he had been born.
lines.note: STORY 1: Jaratkaru the mother kneels to the boy, her hands on his shoulders; behind them, faint, the medallions of episode 32 (the sage, the bride, the boy).

lines.speaker: astika
lines.text: "I will go, uncle. I will set you free."
lines.say: I will go, [p:60] uncle. [p:200] I will set you free.
lines.note: STORY 2 (Astika speaks): the boy, lit gold, looks up at Vasuki's hood; the uncle bows to him.

lines.text: So the boy walked to the king's sacrifice.
lines.say: So the boy walked [p:60] to the king's sacrifice.
lines.note: STORY 3: NEW LIGHT, the plain before the sacrifice at a smoky red noon: the small boy on a long road toward a black smoke column; the enclosure's posts on the horizon.

lines.text: At the gate, the guards would not let him in.
lines.say: At the gate, [p:80] the guards would not let him in.
lines.note: STORY 4: two tall guards cross their spears before the boy (a low angle from behind him); the fire's glow beyond them.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: So he did what he did best. He spoke.
lines.say: So he did what he did best. [p:250] He spoke.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti, a twenty-sixth angle: low behind the fire, the flames between camera and Sauti; he smiles).

lines.speaker: astika
lines.text: "This sacrifice shines like the sacrifices of the gods!"
lines.say: This sacrifice shines [p:80] like the sacrifices of the gods!
lines.note: STORY 5 · THE TURN (≈ 47 %): after the 0.9 s silence: the boy's voice rings out at the gate; the guards turn; behind them the great fire flares gold (beats[0]).

lines.text: He praised the king, the priests, and the fire itself.
lines.say: He praised the king, [p:80] the priests, [p:80] and the fire itself.
lines.note: STORY 6: NEW LIGHT, inside the enclosure (episode 8's sacrifice, now seen at noon through smoke): three quick cuts on the beats: the king on his seat, the four priests in black, the fire.

lines.text: The guards stepped aside. The whole assembly fell silent.
lines.say: The guards stepped aside. [p:250] The whole assembly fell silent.
lines.note: STORY 6b: the spears lift; the boy walks in alone down the long aisle between the seated priests and kings, all heads turning to him.

lines.speaker: janamejaya
lines.text: "A boy, and he speaks like a sage. Choose a boon!"
lines.say: A boy, [p:60] and he speaks like a sage. [p:250] Choose a boon!
lines.note: STORY 7 (Janamejaya speaks): the king rises from his seat, lit by the fire, his hand open toward the small boy (a high-low two-shot, the boy foreground, the king beyond).

lines.text: But first, the priests said, Takshaka must come to the fire.
lines.say: But first, [p:100] the priests said, [p:100] Takshaka must come to the fire.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (cliffhanger, the catalog line): the four priests turn to the sky as one, ladles raised; in the smoke above the fire, the shape of a great green hood far off.
The arc's serpent cartouche over the cliffhanger image; dissolve into frame 1.
